description: Issue #839 AC4, the Turtle & Rendering half of "nothing shadows", and the sharpest of the three shadowing outcomes `docs/design-notes/0007-binding-vs-registration.md` measured: `define forward :n … print 999 … end` then `forward 10` used to run the LEARNER's procedure — printing `999` and emitting ZERO `move` events, so the turtle silently stopped moving and neither stage said anything. Phase-1 registration now raises `ol-reserved-word` (`spec/error-model.md:125`), matching what `check()` already reported. The empty event stream is the assertion that matters: a `print` payload of `999` would mean the shadow is back, and a `move` payload would mean the primitive silently won instead.

diagnostics.message: forward is already part of OpenLogo. choose another name.
